units.rawText: Professor, you've been busy until this late and you still want to keep going? Pulling all-nighters is bad for your health, you know. The Oasis won't explode just because you wrote one fewer email.

units.rawText: So right now, power down and go to sleep... You don't want to? So even you would try to defy me, Professor. Hmhm...
